subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package — next steps and timelines (Aurelia Tech)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@aurelia.tech>, Aurelia Tech Security <security@aurelia.tech>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:15:00 -0800
Subject: MAP draft & SOC 2 package — post-call recap and next steps

Hi Sophie (and team),

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Per our call, attached is the first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the Aurelia <> Redwood pilot. High-level items we discussed are captured; please review and let us know edits. Key items for the security milestone are called out below.

Attached: MAP-draft-20261124.pdf, SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx

Immediate next steps (owners + target dates):
- Security review kickoff (Aurelia Security) — owner: Aurelia Security — target start: 2026-11-26
- SOC 2 package delivery (Redwood) — owner: Redwood Security (Marissa & Neha) — deliverables: questionnaire, evidence list, access instructions — due: 2026-11-30
- Procurement / PO discussion — owner: Rishi — target: 2026-12-03
- Pilot enablement & test API keys — owner: Redwood Eng — target: 2026-12-07

Dependencies called out in the MAP:
- Access to a read-only log export (for evidence collection) — Aurelia Security to confirm availability
- Signed NDA/PO for access to dedicated resources (if needed) — Procurement path TBD

Please flag any incorrect owners or unrealistic dates — we can update the MAP and move dates accordingly.

For the SOC 2 package specifically, we'll provide:
- Completed security questionnaire (attached XLS)
- Evidence index spreadsheet with links to artifacts and expected delivery method (S3/Share)
- Instructions for temporary read-only access and list of required logs
- Contact list for Redwood security reviewers (and preferred SSO/KMS contacts)

If Aurelia's security team prefers a single consolidated package or incremental deliveries, say the word and we'll adjust.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@aurelia.tech>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Aurelia Tech Security <security@aurelia.tech>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks Marissa — adding a couple items from procurement that came up on today’s call:

- Can we propose a target close date in the MAP? I suggest 2026-12-15 for an initial paid pilot (gives security + procurement time).
- I'll own the PO/contract cadence — target to have draft terms to Aurelia by 2026-12-01.
- Please include a short line in the MAP about data residency and retention defaults (we discussed EU options in passing).

Marissa / Neha: for the SOC 2 package, can we confirm format for evidence links (preference: short-lived S3 URLs + index spreadsheet)? Also note that if Aurelia requests on-site artifacts or encrypted buckets, that may affect timing.

Rishi
Director, Commercial Sales | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

---

From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@aurelia.tech>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aurelia Tech Security <security@aurelia.tech>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package — post-call recap and next steps

Marissa / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and the MAP draft. A few notes from security:

- We appreciate the proposed schedule. Our security team can start the kickoff on 2026-11-26 as suggested, but we will need the SOC 2 questionnaire and evidence index by 2026-11-30 to meet internal review windows.
- Preferred evidence delivery: index spreadsheet + short-lived S3 URLs (48-72 hours). Please include file checksums where possible.
- On access: we'll require a read-only IAM role with scoped S3 access and a contact for rapid follow-up during the evidence review window.
- One question: will Redwood redact any customer-identifying data from provided logs/evidence? If so, please call out which artifacts will be redacted.

We can accept an incremental delivery: questionnaire first, then evidence links. For the MAP target close, 2026-12-15 is fine from our side pending procurement timelines.

Sophie Martin
Head of IT Security, Aurelia Tech
sophie.martin@aurelia.tech

---

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@aurelia.tech>, Aurelia Tech Security <security@aurelia.tech>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package — post-call recap and next steps

Thanks Sophie — good notes. We can commit to the incremental delivery model:

Deliverables & schedule (finalized):
- 2026-11-30: Completed SOC 2 questionnaire (attached: SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx) + evidence index (spreadsheet with S3 links)
- 2026-11-30 to 2026-12-04: Evidence review window (short-lived S3 URLs, 72-hour expiry)
- 2026-12-01: Draft commercial terms/PO from Redwood (Rishi owner)
- 2026-12-07: Pilot API keys & initial onboarding
- 2026-12-15: Target close for initial paid pilot

On your questions:
- We'll provide redaction guidance and mark any potentially customer-identifying fields in the evidence index. Redwood will not provide raw customer PII; logs will be filtered and scoped.
- Evidence delivery: Neha will share S3 links and checksums; she'll also include a read-only IAM role name for your team to validate access if you prefer direct role-based verification.

Action items for Aurelia:
- Confirm availability for security kickoff 2026-11-26 (yes/no)
- Confirm whether you prefer receiving evidence via short-lived S3 URLs or via an encrypted Drive share

I'll attach the SOC2 access instructions and evidence index now.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Access_Instructions.pdf, SOC2-evidence-list.xlsx
